standard_prerequisites.name: The classification of invertible modules over a local ring, and the criterion for a finitely presented module with free stalks to be locally free of that rank
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4408-4414) as a pointer to a section of another chapter and to a lemma of this chapter

core_obligations: The parenthetical: the proof exhibits a one point space whose ring has nontrivial Picard group, so that invertible modules need not be free, which shows the hypothesis on the local rings is needed (proof lines 4385-4389)

Locally free implies invertible: over an open covering trivialising the module the evaluation map into the structure sheaf is an isomorphism, so the module is invertible by the characterisation of that lemma (proof lines 4391-4401)

Invertible implies locally free of rank one: assuming the local rings are local, the proof uses that the stalk is an invertible module over a local ring, hence free of rank one, and then upgrades this to local freeness of the sheaf using finite presentation (proof lines 4403-4414)
proof_roadmap: 括号里的反例：取一点空间 X 与环 R，则可逆 O_X-模对应可逆 R-模，故 Pic(R) ≠ 1 时给出非自由例。

正向：L 局部自由秩 1 时，在平凡化开覆盖上赋值映射 L ⊗ Hom(L,O_X) → O_X 是同构，故 L 可逆（lemma-invertible）。反向：若各茎 O_{X,x} 局部且 L 可逆，则 L_x 是可逆 O_{X,x}-模，由局部环的 Picard 分类得 L_x ≅ O_{X,x}；又 L 有限表现，故由 lemma-finite-presentation-stalk-free 得 L 局部自由秩 1。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a locally free module of rank one is invertible, and conversely that an invertible module is locally free of rank one when all local rings are local, the converse failing in general (author lemma at source lines 4376-4382, label lemma-invertible-is-locally-free-rank-1). The proof (source lines 4384-4415) first records a one point counterexample for the parenthetical, then proves that a locally free module of rank one is invertible because the evaluation map is an isomorphism over a trivialising covering, and finally proves the converse by classifying invertible modules over a local ring and upgrading freeness of the stalks to local freeness through finite presentation (proof lines 4385-4414). The converse with its classification step is the content. H2.
